sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Descend in clear terraces toward the oasis.
Pump through the deep oasis basin.
Launch out of the dip across the central pool.
Climb from the basin onto the dune rim.
Reveal the route ahead from an early crest.
Settle wheel contact and rebuild controlled entry speed between the added challenges.
Reach a broad terrace beyond the first oasis circuit.
Cross another dry wash using the established flight timing.
Follow the crowned walkway around the oasis.
Recover in the sheltered outer basin.
Finish release after the last challenge.
